context: Hiroshi-elder watches an opening ceremony on TV with Sho-young.
purpose: Grandfather and grandson sharing TV cultural event.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: おじいちゃん、花火、すごい!
lines.style: Bright, awed gasp on the opening. Small voice filled with genuine wonder, not performance. Quick bright attack on each image. Breathless with delight.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 迎える光景、ようけ綺麗や。
lines.en: What a beautiful sight coming into view.
lines.style: Soft Kansai warmth. Unhurried, savoring each word like he's watching with Sho. Gentle approval in the voice, not explaining — sharing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 飛行機、空に飛ぶ、見える!
lines.en: Look — there's a plane going across the sky too!
lines.style: Quick bright recognition, like spotting something together. Warmth toward Sho's noticing. Eager but not loud — the excitement of a child who trusts he's being listened to.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 同時に、たくさん上がるな。
lines.en: So many rising up at once.
lines.style: Quiet observation. Slight pause between phrases. The tone of someone watching, not narrating. Fond — he's noticing what Sho notices. Almost to himself.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 永遠に、残るような景色!
lines.en: Like a view that will stay forever…
lines.style: Tender, hushed reverence. Catches himself mid-thought. Small voice, like he's discovering the words as he speaks. Slight trailing fade — uncertain if he found the right words.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お前、いい言葉、見つけたな。
lines.style: Warm, measured acknowledgment. Light pause before the praise lands. Not effusive — the pride of someone who doesn't give compliments lightly. Quiet certainty.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 見守ってくれて、ありがとう!
lines.en: Thank you for watching this with me.
lines.style: Soft, genuine gratitude. Voice small and steady. No rush — he means it fully. Slight tremor of emotion, held close. Ends gently, like a gift being offered.
